title: Hall's orders said he could never be briefed or debriefed
summary: Charles Hall tells of Hall's orders said he could never be briefed or debriefed, about 1965-1967 at Indian Springs / Nellis AFB, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I can never be briefed. I can never be debriefed. And the reason is very simple.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he served as an Air Force weather observer at Indian Springs and Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada from 1965 to 1967, says his orders stated he could never be briefed or debriefed, meaning he could never be formally told about, or formally released from, the secret work he was part of. He says the reason was simple and ties it to a figure he calls the Teacher. If true, it would mean his time with what he describes as non-human beings was kept off the official record.
